# Chromium flags<AvailableFrom v="4.0.543" />

## JavaScript API

Adds, replaces, or removes Chrome flags. Keys omit the leading --. true adds a bare flag, a string sets its value, and false removes it. Overrides take precedence over other Chromium options. The user-data-dir and remote-debugging-\* flags are reserved. Defaults to `{}`. Remotion’s default Chrome flags and enabled or disabled features may change between patch versions. There is no guarantee that these defaults remain unchanged.

## Command line

Adds, replaces, or removes Chrome flags. Keys omit the leading --. true adds a bare flag, a string sets its value, and false removes it. Overrides take precedence over other Chromium options. The user-data-dir and remote-debugging-\* flags are reserved. Defaults to `{}`. Pass a JSON object. Remotion’s default Chrome flags and enabled or disabled features may change between patch versions. There is no guarantee that these defaults remain unchanged.

## CLI flag

```text
--chromium-flags <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)
- [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setChromiumFlags({'disable-gpu-rasterization': true, 'disable-gpu-compositing': true});
```
